newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast products steady amid dormant trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast products steady amid dormant trade.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices remained flat, with few cargoes sold in a market nearly abandoned for the Christmas holiday, traders said.
NYMEX January gasoline fell 1.29 cents to 68.90 cents a gallon in late New York trade. Heating oil dropped 1.89 cents a gallon to 71.08 cents.
Bids for Los Angeles unleaded CARB gasoline remained 74 cents a gallon, while offers stayed 75 cents.
CARB diesel held at 73/74 cents a gallon, and "EPA" quality diesel was unchanged at 71/72 cents, traders said.
